name: Bloodcrave
source:
Welcome to Newport, a futuristic city where vampires and other primeval creatures face an existential threat from widespread surveillance and advancing weaponry. You take the role of a young engineer who, one night, gets saved from certain death by a vampire vigilante, Chloe. He decides to join Chloe and her team to challenge the forces ruling the city from the shadows. However, as their fight progresses, the dark influence becomes increasingly seductive. Will you be able to resist the temptations, or will you betray your companions and join forces with the vampire lords?

Or perhaps... will you grab all that power for yourself and seize control of the city?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2312370/Bloodcrave/]Steam[/url]]
